domains.name: Maternal Health Conditions
domains.summary: Variables related to maternal health conditions such as prolonged rupture of membranes, STI status, teen pregnancy, and infections.

domains.name: Maternal Weight and Care
domains.summary: Variables measuring mother's weight, weight gain adequacy, pre-existing hypertension, and other maternal health care factors.

domains.name: Other Maternal Factors
domains.summary: Miscellaneous variables related to other maternal factors including employment issues, history of mental illness, substance use, and other unspecified conditions.

domains.name: Pediatric Care Issues
domains.summary: Variables indicating inadequate pediatric care assessment, inappropriate ER use, missed appointments, multiple providers, lack of referrals, and standard of care issues.

domains.name: Prenatal Care Issues
domains.summary: Variables related to prenatal care including inadequate assessments, late entry to care, missed appointments, multiple providers, no prenatal care, lack of referrals, and standard of care issues.

domains.name: Preconception and Chronic Disease Care
domains.summary: Variables related to preconception care, chronic disease control education at different stages (before, during, after pregnancy), dental care, pregnancy planning/BC education, weight management/dietician services.

domains.name: Service Satisfaction and Eligibility
domains.summary: Variables indicating client dissatisfaction with support services, eligibility issues, inadequate information, lack of child care, poor communication between providers, and other service-related factors.

domains.name: Infant Health in Last 72 Hours
domains.summary: Variables indicating infant health conditions such as apnea, difficulty breathing, choking, cyanosis, diarrhea, fever, fussiness, lethargy, seizures, stool changes, excessive sweating, vomiting, and other disorders.
